faq.q: What can I build on ALR land near Mission?
faq.a: The ALC frame permits one principal residence of at most 500 m², a secondary suite only if it is entirely contained within that principal residence and local bylaws allow suites, and at most one additional detached residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (parcels >40 ha); local governments may further restrict residences through zoning.

faq.q: Are all the listings on this page inside the City of Mission?
faq.a: No — the first page alone spans six board sub-areas, including Lake Errock (FVRD Electoral Area C), Dewdney Deroche (Area G) and Durieu (Area F), which are unincorporated FVRD ground with rural taxes paid to the Province, alongside City of Mission lots that pay City taxes.

faq.q: Who do I pay property tax to on a vacant lot?
faq.a: The government the lot sits in: City of Mission lots pay the City (2026 taxes due July 2, 2026, 10% penalty July 3); rural FVRD lots receive their notice from the Province's Surveyor of Taxes Office and pay the Province, with rural taxes due July 2 and 5% + 5% penalties under the Taxation (Rural Area) Act.
